Goal: Detect repeated synthetic die-pad targets with a project-authored template.
Notes: Public-safe Matching benchmark generated by OpenVisionLab. No SDK sample image is used.

Goal: Reject a synthetic no-target board with the same Matching pipeline.
Notes: Public-safe Matching NG benchmark. The shared pipeline should fail because the target template is absent.

Goal: Count bright synthetic particles in a known public-safe scene.
Notes: Public-safe Blob count benchmark generated by OpenVisionLab. No SDK sample image is used.

Goal: Reject a sparse synthetic particle scene with the same Blob count pipeline.
Notes: Public-safe Blob NG benchmark. The shared pipeline should fail because particle count is below the normal range.

Goal: Count five separated synthetic shapes after simple binary thresholding.
Notes: Public-safe Contour benchmark generated by OpenVisionLab. No SDK sample image is used.

Goal: Reject a missing-shape scene with the same Contour pipeline.
Notes: Public-safe Contour NG benchmark. The shared pipeline should fail because only two target shapes remain.

Goal: Use basic Threshold to isolate four bright inspection pads.
Notes: Public-safe Threshold benchmark generated by OpenVisionLab. No SDK sample image is used.

Goal: Reject a threshold scene where only one bright inspection pad remains.
Notes: Public-safe Threshold NG benchmark. The shared pipeline should fail because the Threshold output contains too few target pads.

Goal: Use MedianBlur to remove small bright salt noise before target counting.
Notes: Public-safe Filter benchmark generated by OpenVisionLab. The shared pipeline should denoise small specks and keep four large targets.

Goal: Reject a denoise scene where only two large targets remain after filtering.
Notes: Controlled NG Filter benchmark. The same pipeline should fail because denoise cannot create missing target regions.

Goal: Extract shape boundaries with Canny and count the resulting target outlines.
Notes: Public-safe EdgeDetection benchmark generated by OpenVisionLab. The shared pipeline should turn four shape boundaries into four contour regions.

Goal: Reject an edge scene where only two target outlines remain.
Notes: Controlled NG EdgeDetection benchmark. The same pipeline should fail because edge extraction cannot create missing shapes.

Goal: Remove small bright specks with Morphology Open before contour counting.
Notes: Public-safe Morphology benchmark generated by OpenVisionLab. The shared pipeline should clean specks and keep four targets.

Goal: Reject a morphology cleanup scene where only two cleaned targets remain.
Notes: Controlled NG Morphology benchmark. The same pipeline should fail because cleanup leaves too few target regions.

Goal: Verify that a synthetic inspection field stays inside the normal brightness band.
Notes: Public-safe Mean benchmark generated by OpenVisionLab. No SDK sample image is used.

Goal: Reject a synthetic underexposed field with the same Mean brightness pipeline.
Notes: Public-safe Mean NG benchmark. The shared pipeline should fail because average brightness is below the normal range.

Goal: Use Arithmetic Bitwise_NOT to invert a dark inspection field and verify the bright result band.
Notes: Public-safe Arithmetic benchmark generated by OpenVisionLab. The shared pipeline should invert dark pixels into a bright review result.

Goal: Reject a bright source field because Bitwise_NOT produces a dark result outside the expected inverted band.
Notes: Controlled NG Arithmetic benchmark. The same pipeline should fail because inversion cannot produce the expected bright result from an already bright field.

Goal: Use HSV color range masking to isolate four red inspection patches.
Notes: Public-safe HSV benchmark generated by OpenVisionLab. The shared pipeline should pass because red mask coverage is inside the expected ratio band.

Goal: Reject an HSV color patch scene where most red target patches are missing.
Notes: Controlled NG HSV benchmark. The same pipeline should fail because the selected red mask ratio is below the normal range.

Goal: Match a feature-rich synthetic card using a project-authored template crop.
Notes: Public-safe FeatureMatching benchmark generated by OpenVisionLab. No SDK sample image is used.

Goal: Reject a wrong synthetic feature card with the same FeatureMatching pipeline.
Notes: Public-safe FeatureMatching NG benchmark. The shared pipeline should fail because feature geometry/score is below the normal target gate.

Goal: Match an asymmetric synthetic L fiducial by edge geometry.
Notes: Public-safe EdgeBasedMatching benchmark generated by OpenVisionLab. No SDK sample image is used.

Goal: Reject a wrong synthetic edge fiducial with the same EdgeBasedMatching pipeline.
Notes: Public-safe EdgeBasedMatching NG benchmark. The shared pipeline should return no result because the edge geometry is different from the taught L fiducial.

Goal: Measure spacing between synthetic vertical pin edges.
Notes: Public-safe LineDistance benchmark generated by OpenVisionLab. No SDK sample image is used.

Goal: Reject a synthetic pin width drift image with the same LineDistance pipeline.
Notes: Public-safe LineDistance NG benchmark. The shared pipeline should fail because measured distance is below the normal range.

Goal: Resize a project-authored geometry target to 50 percent with RotateScale.
Notes: Public-safe RotateScale geometry benchmark generated by OpenVisionLab. No SDK sample image is used.

Goal: Reject a geometry source with unexpected width because the same 50 percent resize no longer produces the expected output size.
Notes: Controlled NG RotateScale benchmark. The shared pipeline should fail against the normal output-size gate because the input width drift changes the resized width.
